gaps.title: Define admin information architecture and launch-minimum controls before UX
gaps.ma_concept: MA cross-device Admin, Activity, Audit and Files board structure
gaps.mp_evidence: docs/planning/aws-options-2026-11-01/audit-observability-requirements.md section3 lists eight portal areas; current MP phase map remains umbrella-level outside detailed L1.
gaps.recommendation: Prepare an MP admin domain map covering Files/Imports, Audit, Runs/Health, Agents/Models/Evals, Approvals/Config, Costs/Budgets, Incidents/Recovery, Identity/Devices. Keep owner-only personal scope; do not import household-member administration or copy MA board styling.
gaps.decision_needed: Approve launch-minimum versus later depth, navigation/domain boundaries and action permissions before screen design.
acceptance_criteria: Every launch-sensitive action has a defined path, observable pending/failure/cancel/rejected state and evidence drill-down.
Read-only cost/audit access is distinct from controls that change budgets, data or model state.
Mobile and web workflows share backend contracts but have separately specified recovery/privacy/accessibility states.
Phase pages cite actual MP stories/contracts and clearly distinguish planned UI from implemented functionality.

gaps.title: Specify personal identity linking, sessions and owner recovery
gaps.ma_concept: MA multi-provider links, devices, revocation and two independent sign-in paths
gaps.mp_evidence: docs/planning/aws-options-2026-11-01/DEC-037/038 retains Cognito managed login, verified linking, Apple/Google/passkeys and two independent paths; detailed recovery remains open.
gaps.recommendation: Design personal-owner recovery rather than household invites. Link only after verified control of both identities, use stable provider subjects rather than email equality and avoid unlinking the final usable path. Define web cookies/native secure storage and live-stream reauthorization.
gaps.decision_needed: Approve trusted origins/RP IDs, recovery inventory, session/stream revocation latency and loss-of-all-devices procedure.
acceptance_criteria: Email collision cannot merge identities or grant access; linking/recovery changes require current owner authorization.
Revoked sessions cannot keep an SSE connection/data link indefinitely; explicit maximum delay is tested.
A lost device can be revoked using an independent verified path without disabling the only owner irrecoverably.
Dev/prod origin, issuer, audience, callback and passkey scope are explicit and fail on cross-environment tokens.

gaps.title: Separate material investment alerts from operational incident routing
gaps.ma_concept: MA alert router, quiet hours, cooldowns, recovery and budget ladder
gaps.mp_evidence: docs/planning/aws-options-2026-11-01/DEC-032/033 and audit-observability-requirements.md section5 approve07:30London,22:00–07:00quiet hours and defined exceptions; severity/cooldowns remain open.
gaps.recommendation: Maintain separate financial-risk, system-security, data-quality, billing and job-failure alert classes with correlation/dedup, explicit evidence and recovery state. Product push channels remain native/PWA plus app/chat; additional operator email is a choice.
gaps.decision_needed: Approve material/critical conditions, quiet-hour exceptions, grouping/cooldowns, emergency channel and weekend briefing.
acceptance_criteria: A downstream outage produces one incident with linked symptoms rather than one push per failed component.
Risk alerts use eligible as-of data; unavailable providers cannot generate a confident all-clear.
Push provider acceptance is labelled delivery attempt/acceptance, not proof the owner read it.
Alert policy edits are versioned/audited; recovery notifications link the incident and do not erase prior failures.

gaps.title: Freeze the canonical MP baseline and detailed story trace
gaps.ma_concept: One source per record, area specifications and a phase/story/design trace.
gaps.mp_evidence: Ten phase drafts coexist with a historical six-phase implementation plan; 48 non-import stories are umbrella drafts.
gaps.recommendation: Keep PH identifiers, assign one current authority and explicitly supersede bootstrap conflicts. Decompose every relevant acceptance into MP contracts/tests and actual Jira stories before UX starts; retain MA provenance without copying dates or permissions.
gaps.decision_needed: Approve architecture baseline structure, epic crosswalk and story readiness protocol.
acceptance_criteria: Record versioned requirements, ADRs, contracts, phase/story links and source dispositions; no local draft ID is presented as Jira.
All implementation stories have specific positive/negative acceptance, data/authority contracts, state inventory and dependency evidence before the UX gate.
Architecture, complete UX and explicit build permission have separate owner approvals.

gaps.title: Track rich-source limitations and MP visual evidence
gaps.ma_concept: Source design boards and native Lucid/static/motion explainers accompany architecture and phase records.
gaps.mp_evidence: Current MA text and board references inspected; all native media/animation pixels have not been certified. MP has existing native Lucid and Site exports.
gaps.recommendation: Maintain a separate evidence state for source text, board semantics and actual visual inspection. Reuse MP native diagrams as proposed, update only for selected architecture and preserve exact versions/hashes. Create MP UX after baseline approval, not copied MA boards.
gaps.decision_needed: Approve required architecture/phase visual set and source-review boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Every significant component and interface has a readable technical view with native AWS components and trust boundaries.
Each visual records source, version, export hash and current/proposed status; reduced-motion/static alternatives retained.
Uninspected referenced material remains visible as a limitation; no complete visual-parity claim.

gaps.title: Decide whether usage-based UI personalisation belongs in MP
gaps.recommendation: Default to static owner-configurable ordering until owner explicitly approves bounded personalisation; do not inherit autonomous reordering.
gaps.decision_needed: Whether taps/corrections/mutes may influence presentation order, and with what consent/retention/reset controls.
acceptance_criteria: Only first-party owner signals; untrusted documents/news cannot teach preferences.
Visible learned settings, reset/opt-out and retention; no automatic records/forecasts/ranking/alert-policy changes.
Deidentify and separately approve any corrected import promoted into an evaluation case.
gaps.ma_concept: Relevant shared concept found in expanded live MA issue capture.
gaps.mp_evidence: source-issue-reconciliation.json; candidate scope, not an owner-approved feature.

gaps.title: Decide export and cross-app retirement boundaries
gaps.recommendation: Treat owner export/reproducibility as a candidate MP contract; do not inherit DNS handover, wealth-tracker retirement or automatic migration.
gaps.decision_needed: Required ledger/forecast/audit export formats and any optional MA file interchange.
acceptance_criteria: Exports pin schema/as-of/provenance and respect owner/environment isolation.
Creation/access/deletion is audited; no public object URL by default.
Named later cutover approval precedes any MA job/resource/issue/history retirement.

owner_directions.meaning: DynamoDB operational records and encrypted S3 originals selected as the storage direction. One backend write service owns owner-confirmed financial changes and corresponding audit/outbox evidence; agents may prepare drafts but cannot commit directly. Access patterns, precision, concurrency, large imports, query fit, recovery and export decisions remain open. No build or full architecture approval.
